_doc: Per-figure parsing fixes keyed by figure id. Keys: skip (bool), x ('category'), dataRow (1-based first data row), dropColumns (series names, after numbering of duplicates), latestBlock (long-format sheet: keep the rows of the latest date, column B as categories), transpose (category sheet with years as columns), keepZeros (keep zeros at the end of series that would otherwise be read as missing values).
